description: Use this when the user is preparing for an interview and wants likely questions, for a specific job or in general. Interview questions to practise, each with what the interviewer is listening for, plus STAR answer tips. With a job_description, questions come from its skills and duties, along with what to research and questions to ask; with resume_text, from the user's own roles. Rule-based.

job_description.description: Optional. The job posting as plain text.

kind.description: Optional. One group: posting, resume, about, behavioural, role or closing. Default all.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

name: interview_questions
title: Interview practice questions
